# Local LaTeX dependency

`stfloats.sty` (v3.4, 2025-06-18) is an unmodified generated file from the
CTAN sttools bundle by Sigitas Tolusis. It enables bottom placement of
full-width floats in two-column manuscripts. The corresponding source
`stfloats.dtx` and the upstream bundle README are included.

Source: http://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/sttools.zip
License: LaTeX Project Public License 1.3 or later; see the source headers.
The local copy keeps manuscript compilation independent of automatic package installation.
